zh.title: YNX Wallet
zh.headline: 一个钱包，连接你的 YNX 体验
zh.summary: 查看资产、管理账户和备份，在同一个钱包里使用收款、转账与 Pay。当前提供测试网预览，具体能力以所选平台和可用服务为准。

capabilities.title: 账户与备份
capabilities.body: 管理钱包账户，使用加密备份与恢复功能。请妥善保管密码和备份。

capabilities.title: 收款与转账
capabilities.body: 使用收款地址或二维码，核对网络、地址与金额后再确认转账。

capabilities.title: Pay 与扫码
capabilities.body: 钱包内整合支付请求与扫码入口。二维码不是付款完成凭证；实际支付需要可用服务和明确授权。

capabilities.title: 记录与恢复
capabilities.body: 查看交易记录，恢复中保留未明确完成的交易状态，避免误认为已成功或重复提交。

zh.previewNotice: 测试网预览，不代表正式签名、应用商店发行或全部业务流程已验收。
zh.illustrationLabel: 产品示意图 · 非真实账户或交易凭证

en.title: YNX Wallet
en.headline: One wallet for your YNX experience
en.summary: View assets, manage accounts and backups, and access receive, send and Pay in one wallet. Testnet previews are available; capabilities depend on the selected platform and available services.

capabilities.title: Accounts and backups
capabilities.body: Manage wallet accounts with encrypted backup and recovery. Keep passwords and backups safe.

capabilities.title: Receive and send
capabilities.body: Use a receiving address or QR code. Review the network, address and amount before confirming a transfer.

capabilities.title: Pay and scanning
capabilities.body: Payment requests and scanning belong in the wallet. A QR code is not a payment receipt; payment requires available services and explicit authorization.

capabilities.title: History and recovery
capabilities.body: Review transaction history and preserve unresolved states during recovery to avoid false success or duplicate submission.

en.previewNotice: Testnet preview. Production signing, store release and acceptance of every business flow are not claimed.
en.illustrationLabel: Product illustration · not a real account or transaction receipt
